verdict.rationale: Anytype documents several first-party ways to connect external AI tools to notes. There is a local API bundled with the desktop app and an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact with Anytype through natural language. There is also an open-source agents-skill toolkit for Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot that can read, search, modify and bulk-edit Objects, plus a headless CLI for automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these connectors work as documented.
